In six-dimensional [[geometry]], a '''cantellated 5-cube''' is a convex [[uniform 5-polytope]], being a [[cantellation]] of the regular [[5-cube]].

There are 6 unique cantellation for the 5-cube, including truncations. Half of them are more easily constructed from the dual [[5-orthoplex]]

{{TOC left}}
{{-}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Small rhombated penteract (Acronym: sirn) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/sirn.htm (o3o3x3o4x - sirn)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The [[Cartesian coordinate]]s of the vertices of a ''cantellated 5-cube'' having edge length&nbsp;2 are all permutations of:

:<math>\left(\pm1,\ \pm1,\ \pm(1+\sqrt{2}),\ \pm(1+\sqrt{2}),\ \pm(1+\sqrt{2})\right)</math>

=== Images ===
{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t02|150}}

In [[Five-dimensional space|five-dimensional]] [[geometry]], a '''bicantellated 5-cube''' is a [[uniform 5-polytope]].

=== Alternate names ===
* Bicantellated penteract, bicantellated 5-orthoplex, or bicantellated pentacross
* Small birhombated penteractitriacontaditeron (Acronym: sibrant) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/sibrant.htm (o3x3o3x4o - sibrant)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The [[Cartesian coordinate]]s of the vertices of a ''bicantellated 5-cube'' having edge length&nbsp;2 are all permutations of:
:(0,1,1,2,2)

=== Images ===
{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t13|150}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Tricantitruncated 5-orthoplex / tricantitruncated pentacross
* Great rhombated penteract (girn) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/girn.htm (o3o3x3x4x - girn)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The [[Cartesian coordinate]]s of the vertices of a cantitruncated 5-cube having an edge length of&nbsp;2 are given by all permutations of coordinates and sign of:

:<math>\left(1,\ 1+\sqrt{2},\ 1+2\sqrt{2},\ 1+2\sqrt{2},\ 1+2\sqrt{2}\right)</math>

=== Images ===
{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t012|150}}

=== Related polytopes ===
It is third in a series of cantitruncated hypercubes:
{{Cantitruncated hypercube polytopes}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Bicantitruncated penteract
* Bicantitruncated pentacross
* Great birhombated penteractitriacontaditeron (Acronym: gibrant) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/gibrant.htm (o3x3x3x4o - gibrant)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of a bicantitruncated 5-cube, centered at the origin, are all sign and coordinate [[permutation]]s of
: (±3,±3,±2,±1,0)

=== Images ===
{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t123|150}}
